item.gscraft.duct_tape.tip: Hardware. Holds a wiring harness together.

item.gscraft.wire_spool.tip: Electrical. Three make a wiring harness with a cord and tape.
item.gscraft.capacitor.tip: Electrical. A circuit assembly wants two.
item.gscraft.circuit_board.tip: Electrical. The heart of a circuit assembly.
item.gscraft.relay.tip: Electrical. A circuit assembly wants one.
item.gscraft.light_bulb.tip: Electrical. Michael wants one to light the compound.
item.gscraft.hard_drive.tip: Electrical. Office salvage; Tune reads them.
item.gscraft.broken_radio.tip: Valuables. Tune can make a map of it.
item.gscraft.water_filter.tip: Filters. A filter cartridge starts here.
item.gscraft.painkillers.tip: Medical. A med kit wants one blister.
item.gscraft.antiseptic.tip: Medical. A med kit wants one.
item.gscraft.syringe.tip: Medical. A med kit wants one.
item.gscraft.canned_goods.tip: Food. Apartments are full of it.
item.gscraft.cloth.tip: Two wool or four string at any station; sandbags and storage want it.
item.gscraft.damaged_pistol.tip: Salvage. The salvaging table takes it apart.
item.gscraft.wrench.tip: Tool. Walker's first gift; three metal scrap at a station.
item.gscraft.welding_torch.tip: Tool. A steel frame is welded; sits in the station's tool slot.
item.gscraft.fastener_kit.tip: 4 bolts, 4 nuts, 4 screws, 4 nails; two minutes at a station.
item.gscraft.steel_frame.tip: 6 metal scrap and a fastener kit, welded; two minutes.
item.gscraft.wiring_harness.tip: 3 wire spools, a power cord, duct tape; two minutes.
item.gscraft.filter_cartridge.tip: A water filter, a corrugated hose, bleach; two minutes.
item.gscraft.circuit_assembly.tip: A circuit board, 2 capacitors, a relay, a wire spool; two minutes.
item.gscraft.med_kit.tip: 2 bandages, painkillers, antiseptic, a syringe; two minutes. Heals a wound.
item.gscraft.casings.tip: 2 metal scrap make 16, quick, at a station.
item.gscraft.powder.tip: Gunpowder and solvent make 4, quick, at a station.

item.gscraft.card_powder.tip: Put it in a station's card slot; the station lists what the powder needs.

gscraft.item.bulky: Bulky: slow to carry, cannot sprint
gscraft.say.tune.join_1: You're up. This is the compound — the yard you're standing in, the big hall east of you, the brick works past it, the wall all round.
gscraft.say.tune.join_2: Walker's in the yard and Michael's in the brick works. Right-click them; they'll tell you what they need.
gscraft.say.tune.join_3: Your journal's on J, your notebook's in your pack, your station too — put that down inside the wall. Marshall wants the north gate shut before dark.
gscraft.say.tune.map: Press M for the map. Middle-mouse pings a spot for everyone.
gscraft.say.walker.hello: Bolts and nuts. The town's full of them — bring me eight of each and we start.
gscraft.say.tony.hello: Bandages and painkillers. The clinic's shelves are bare, and the town's aren't.
gscraft.say.michael.hello: Wire. Spools of it, a cord that still bends, a water filter. Then we get lights.
gscraft.say.tune.hello: A circuit board, two capacitors, and a radio somebody dropped. I can hear the town from here; I'd like to hear further.
gscraft.say.james.hello: The crossing east of here, and the field under the mast. Walk them and I'll put them on your map.
gscraft.say.marshall.hello: The gatehouse holds. Get me the other four's word and we'll talk about the hospital.
gscraft.say.walker.station: Card in the station's top-left slot, the parts in the rows under it. Two minutes a kit — bring me two.
gscraft.say.michael.lights: There. Now we can see what's coming.
gscraft.say.marshall.speaks: We're squatting in someone's town. Clear it and it's ours. Start north — there's a hospital up that road. Ask James what's in it first.
gscraft.say.marshall.marker_set: Marker's in. Five minutes — hold it, and stay inside.
gscraft.say.marshall.marker_refused: James hasn't been. Neither have you.
gscraft.say.marshall.nobody: That's nobody's ground. The marker goes down at a strongpoint.
gscraft.say.marshall.assault_lost: The marker's down. Craft another and we go again.
item.gscraft.station.tip: Your work station. Put it down inside the wire; it answers only to you.
gscraft.station.no_card: put a blueprint card in the top-left slot
gscraft.strike.tip.mortar: 15 seconds to the spotting round, then six rounds. Stay clear of the smoke.
gscraft.strike.tip.artillery: 20 seconds to the spotting round, then eight heavy rounds, wide. Stay well clear.
gscraft.strike.tip.air: 20 seconds to the Cobra: rockets on the smoke, then guns for five seconds. Keep your head down.
gscraft.strike.tip.cooldown: Each grenade has its own clock: the tube three minutes, the guns five, the Cobra eight.
gscraft.say.marshall.fire_mission: Fire mission on the smoke. Fifteen seconds — get clear of it.
gscraft.say.marshall.fire_for_effect: Guns on the smoke, fire for effect. Twenty seconds — well clear.
gscraft.say.marshall.air_support: Cobra's up. Twenty seconds to the smoke — heads down when she comes over.
gscraft.say.marshall.tube_hot: The tube's hot. Three minutes between calls.
gscraft.say.marshall.tube: That's a tube. Shells from the station, six a call — and one call at a time.
item.gscraft.strike_mortar.tip: Marshall's tube. Throw it; the smoke marks the target.
item.gscraft.strike_artillery.tip: The strongpoints' guns. Throw it; the smoke marks the target.
item.gscraft.strike_air.tip: Tune's call to the Cobra. Throw it; the smoke marks the run.
item.gscraft.card_mortar_shell.tip: Put it in a station's card slot; the station lists what the shell needs.
gscraft.say.marshall.guns_hot: The guns are still laying. Five minutes between calls.
gscraft.say.tune.air_busy: She's refuelling. Eight minutes before she's back up.
